name: travel-visits-every-point
description: travel hands the driver each point in order and leaves the device at the last one.
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: travel
env: {}

    points:

        longitude: 10
      - latitude: 10
        longitude: 10.001
      - latitude: 10.001
        longitude: 10.001
